What is included The first row contains recognized column names and the example rows show the expected format. supplier amount currency lead_time_days moq supplier_email supplier_notes Maple Steel Co. 97500 CAD 12 25 sales@maplesteel.example DAP Toronto; Net 30 Nimbus Metals 92800 USD 18 20 quotes@nimbus.example Freight excluded; tax unknown Use one row per supplier quote Price, currency, lead time, MOQ, supplier email, and notes remain separate so a missing field is visible instead of being silently assumed. supplier amount currency lead_time_days moq supplier_email supplier_notes How to use the template 1 Download the CSV and open it in your preferred spreadsheet tool. 2 Replace the example rows with one row for each supplier quotation. 3 Keep currency as a three-letter code such as USD, CAD, EUR, BRL, INR, or NGN. 4 Upload the completed CSV through QuoteStack’s bulk quote importer when you are ready. Template questions Can I use this without QuoteStack? Yes. It is a standard CSV file and works as a standalone comparison sheet. Will the file import into QuoteStack? Yes. The included headers match QuoteStack’s current bulk importer: supplier, amount, currency, lead_time_days, moq, supplier_email, and supplier_notes. What about freight, tax, and Incoterms? Use supplier_notes for those details in the lightweight bulk template. For structured freight, tax, line items, and terms, upload the source quote document for review. Ready to move beyond the spreadsheet? Import the completed file, attach source documents, and keep the comparison and approval trail together.
